traditional: A 係 B 嘅化身
jyutping: A hai6 B ge3 faa3 san1

boxes.meaning: A is the embodiment of B

english.meaning: embody; be a perfect example of
english.note: Use this construction when a person or thing embodies a quality and is its perfect example.
Use this when a person or thing literally personifies or seems to be the incarnation of a quality B.

examples.english: To personify perseverance, look no further than my mum.
examples.jyutping: aa3 maa1 hai6 gin1 ngai6 ge3 faa3 san1
keoi5 hai6 zing3 ji6 ge3 faa3 san1
